_comment: Server-owned creature catalog. One entry per species: the scene that renders it, its base stats (the encounter director scales them by level), resistances, loot table and display data. Encounters in spawn_tables.json name a species by its id here.
_resist_note: resist[element] is a damage reduction fraction: 0.5 takes half, -1.0 takes double. Elements come from spells.json `element`. Absent = 0 (normal damage).
_elite_note: Any ordinary (non-boss) pack member may roll elite on each spawn. An elite is a stronger copy of the same species with its own label colour, more experience and an extra guaranteed loot roll.
_level_gap_note: Metin2-style level gap. diff = mob level - player level. Experience and loot drop chances are scaled by the first band whose `min_diff` the diff reaches (bands sorted high to low).
